title: Apple Account 2FA on this Mac: allow the alert, read the code window
symptom: A web or app sign-in asks for a code sent to this Mac; a system alert must be allowed and the code read from a system window. Older macOS: 'Apple Account sign-in requested' (Allow · Don't Allow). macOS 27.x: 'Signed-in Apple Account' with Details · Don't Allow · Allow · Close. Korean UI labels (macOS 27.2) are in keywords
cause: macOS shows the request as a Notification Center alert with hidden actions (Allow, Don't Allow) and the code in a floating FollowUpUI window (CoreFollowUp, layer 25) that also holds keyboard focus
fix: Ask the user first: Allow approves a sign-in to their Apple Account. Only for the sign-in this session just started (the alert appears within about a minute after the web 'Sign In' click)
launch_cli.py desktop wait --window overlay --text "Apple" --timeout 60, then click --ref <ref> --action "<Allow from named_actions>" --confirm-mutating after the user agrees
launch_cli.py desktop tree --window overlay  # the code is a static text with spaces, e.g. '4 1 9   2 0 1'; remove the spaces
Press the code window's Done button with --confirm-mutating so it returns keyboard focus
Six separate code boxes on the web page: web click --frame Widget --ref 1 (first box), then web type --frame Widget --keys <code> --delay-ms 120
A wrong or partial entry invalidates the code; resend once from the page and do not retry in a loop (the account can be locked)
